messages:
nora_cs: Heads-up team — Scion reserved pool bring-up tomorrow 07:00 PDT. Need quick confirm: quota, autoscale policy, and load run plan. @sam_infra @jamie_sre @tess_ops

nora_cs: Short checklist: 1) Reserve pool id 2) soft quota during shadow 3) hard quota after validation 4) 15m shadow @65% then 8m smoke @100% 5) tag runs scion-renew-2026 and export CSV

sam_infra: Reserving now. Propose soft_concurrent=1600, hard=2300, burst=2600 for 10m.

jamie_sre: Autoscale: min_instances=2, max_instances=26, cooldown=60s, target_p95=300ms. Fallback model ready (quant-small). Trigger fallback if p95>800ms for 90s.

tess_ops: Product wants p95, error-rate, cost/1k tokens, fallback_count, cache_hit. Tag runs for CSV.

nora_cs: Can someone paste the exact k6 run to add to the playbook?

jamie_sre: ```
# shadow (15m @65%)
k6 run --vus 130 --duration 15m loadtests/scion-shadow.js \  --env TARGET=https://staging-api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \  --tag run=scion-shadow-65 --tag phase=shadow --header "X-Shadow-Account: scion" --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086

# smoke (8m @100%)
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 8m loadtests/scion-smoke.js \  --env TARGET=https://staging-api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \  --tag run=scion-smoke-100 --tag phase=smoke --header "X-Shadow-Account: scion" --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086
```

deploy-bot: reserved pool created (id: rp-10177). Autoscale policy `scion-dedicated-v1` attached.

sam_infra: rp-10177 live. I'll keep hard quota off until 15m after shadow. Soft-cap active during shadow.

jamie_sre: Oncall: jamie_sre primary, sam_infra secondary. Increasing trace retention to 14d for this run. Rollback rule posted in runbook.

tess_ops: I'll run the enablement survey post-run and attach to renewal notes.

nora_cs: Summary: rp-10177, policy scion-dedicated-v1, shadow 15m@65% -> smoke 8m@100%, pre-run 06:30 PDT, oncall jamie/sam, tag scion-renew-2026. I'll export CSV and summary after. Good luck. :thumbsup:

jamie_sre: See you tomorrow.

(End of thread)
